items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: John Handy is an old time. I guess John Handy, I don't know if I remember him. He was an old man when I was a young one.

ctx.x: All right. Good. I've been hearing about you for so many years now. It's been, I guess, eight years now I've been hearing about you. Something like that. You know, from the Brunies boys and different people that took up after you, you know, that they admire. A clarinet player from the name of John Handy that told me about you.
John Handy is an old time. I guess John Handy, I don't know if I remember him. He was an old man when I was a young one.
